http_ratelimit.name: RunRate zone rate limits
http_ratelimit.description: RunRate Advisory edge rate limiting for high-risk application routes.

rules.description: Free-plan edge burst guard: sensitive public write/report APIs, 5 requests per IP per 10 seconds
rules.expression: (http.request.uri.path eq "/api/contact" or http.request.uri.path eq "/api/assessment/calculate" or (starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/api/assessment/") and (ends_with(http.request.uri.path, "/narrative") or ends_with(http.request.uri.path, "/deliver") or ends_with(http.request.uri.path, "/report"))))

response.content: {"error":"Too many requests. Please wait before retrying."}

rules.description: Plan-limited template: public assessment and analytics event endpoints, 10 requests per IP per minute; disabled because this zone permits one edge rate-limit rule
rules.expression: (http.host in {"www.runrategroup.com" "runrategroup.com"} and (http.request.uri.path eq "/api/assessment/events" or http.request.uri.path eq "/api/analytics/events"))

response.content: {"error":"Too many requests. Please wait before retrying."}

rules.description: Future auth strict template: login/reset/auth endpoints, 5 requests per IP per minute
Future auth moderate template: registration/token refresh, 10 requests per IP per minute
rules.expression: (http.host in {"www.runrategroup.com" "runrategroup.com"} and (http.request.uri.path eq "/register" or http.request.uri.path contains "/token" or http.request.uri.path contains "/refresh"))

http_request_firewall_custom.name: RunRate custom WAF and bot controls
http_request_firewall_custom.description: RunRate Advisory custom edge WAF, bot controls, and route hardening.

rules.description: Defense-in-depth: challenge direct admin requests missing Cloudflare Access authenticated email header
rules.expression: (http.host in {"www.runrategroup.com" "runrategroup.com"} and starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/admin/") and not http.request.headers["cf-access-authenticated-user-email"][0] contains "@runrategroup.com")

rules.description: Log likely SQL injection patterns in query string or URI path
rules.expression: (http.host in {"www.runrategroup.com" "runrategroup.com"} and not (starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/_next/") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/static/") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/assets/") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/images/") or ends_with(http.request.uri.path, ".css") or ends_with(http.request.uri.path, ".js") or ends_with(http.request.uri.path, ".mjs") or ends_with(http.request.uri.path, ".map") or ends_with(http.request.uri.path, ".png") or ends_with(http.request.uri.path, ".jpg") or ends_with(http.request.uri.path, ".jpeg") or ends_with(http.request.uri.path, ".gif") or ends_with(http.request.uri.path, ".webp") or ends_with(http.request.uri.path, ".svg") or ends_with(http.request.uri.path, ".ico") or ends_with(http.request.uri.path, ".woff") or ends_with(http.request.uri.path, ".woff2") or ends_with(http.request.uri.path, ".ttf") or ends_with(http.request.uri.path, ".otf") or ends_with(http.request.uri.path, ".mp4") or ends_with(http.request.uri.path, ".webm") or ends_with(http.request.uri.path, ".pdf")) and (lower(http.request.uri.query) contains "union select" or lower(http.request.uri.query) contains "union%20select" or lower(http.request.uri.query) contains " or 1=1" or lower(http.request.uri.query) contains "or%201%3d1" or lower(http.request.uri.query) contains "' or '1'='1" or lower(http.request.uri.query) contains "%27%20or%20%271%27%3d%271" or lower(http.request.uri.query) contains "information_schema" or lower(http.request.uri.path) contains "union select" or lower(http.request.uri.path) contains "union%20select"))

rules.description: Log likely XSS payloads in query string or URI path
rules.expression: (http.host in {"www.runrategroup.com" "runrategroup.com"} and not (starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/_next/") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/static/") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/assets/") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/images/") or ends_with(http.request.uri.path, ".css") or ends_with(http.request.uri.path, ".js") or ends_with(http.request.uri.path, ".mjs") or ends_with(http.request.uri.path, ".map") or ends_with(http.request.uri.path, ".png") or ends_with(http.request.uri.path, ".jpg") or ends_with(http.request.uri.path, ".jpeg") or ends_with(http.request.uri.path, ".gif") or ends_with(http.request.uri.path, ".webp") or ends_with(http.request.uri.path, ".svg") or ends_with(http.request.uri.path, ".ico") or ends_with(http.request.uri.path, ".woff") or ends_with(http.request.uri.path, ".woff2") or ends_with(http.request.uri.path, ".ttf") or ends_with(http.request.uri.path, ".otf") or ends_with(http.request.uri.path, ".mp4") or ends_with(http.request.uri.path, ".webm") or ends_with(http.request.uri.path, ".pdf")) and (lower(http.request.uri.query) contains "<script" or lower(http.request.uri.query) contains "%3cscript" or lower(http.request.uri.query) contains "javascript:" or lower(http.request.uri.query) contains "javascript%3a" or lower(http.request.uri.query) contains "onload=" or lower(http.request.uri.query) contains "onload%3d" or lower(http.request.uri.query) contains "onerror=" or lower(http.request.uri.query) contains "onerror%3d" or lower(http.request.uri.path) contains "%3cscript"))

(http.host in {"www.runrategroup.com" "runrategroup.com"} and not (starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/_next/") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/static/") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/assets/") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/images/") or ends_with(http.request.uri.path, ".css") or ends_with(http.request.uri.path, ".js") or ends_with(http.request.uri.path, ".mjs") or ends_with(http.request.uri.path, ".map") or ends_with(http.request.uri.path, ".png") or ends_with(http.request.uri.path, ".jpg") or ends_with(http.request.uri.path, ".jpeg") or ends_with(http.request.uri.path, ".gif") or ends_with(http.request.uri.path, ".webp") or ends_with(http.request.uri.path, ".svg") or ends_with(http.request.uri.path, ".ico") or ends_with(http.request.uri.path, ".woff") or ends_with(http.request.uri.path, ".woff2") or ends_with(http.request.uri.path, ".ttf") or ends_with(http.request.uri.path, ".otf") or ends_with(http.request.uri.path, ".mp4") or ends_with(http.request.uri.path, ".webm") or ends_with(http.request.uri.path, ".pdf")) and (http.request.uri.path contains "../" or lower(http.request.uri.path) contains "..%2f" or lower(http.request.uri.path) contains "%2e%2e%2f" or lower(http.request.uri.path) contains "/etc/passwd" or lower(http.request.uri.query) contains "../" or lower(http.request.uri.query) contains "..%2f" or lower(http.request.uri.query) contains "/etc/passwd"))

rules.description: Optional: managed challenge likely bots on sensitive public routes when Bot Management is available
rules.expression: (http.host in {"www.runrategroup.com" "runrategroup.com"} and cf.bot_management.score lt 30 and not cf.client.bot and (http.request.uri.path eq "/api/contact" or http.request.uri.path eq "/api/assessment/calculate" or http.request.uri.path eq "/assessment" or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/admin/")))
